recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dinesh Gundu Rao**, **Health and Family Welfare Minister of Karnataka**, addressed concerns about medicine supply at primary health centres (PHCs) in the state.  He stated that while some issues exist, drugs are available at district and taluk hospitals, with 534 drugs procured through bidding and another 356 locally. The government is streamlining drug procurement processes, including a new tender process that allows newcomers and staggered supply instead of yearly stock. To ensure quality control, a one-month quarantine period will be implemented after procuring drugs.

recent_articles.title: BJP romps home with three Rajya Sabha seats in Odisha, BJD content with one seat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** secured three seats in the biennial Rajya Sabha elections, with independent candidate Dilip Ray winning despite large-scale cross-voting by BJD and Congress MLAs.  **BJD** leader Naveen Patnaik criticized the cross-voting as "betrayal" while **Congress** leaders condemned the action. **BJP** President Manmohan Samal and sitting MP Sujeet Kumar also won comfortably with first preference votes from party MLAs.

recent_articles.title: Assam polls: BJP keeps tribal council-based ally in limbo - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The BJP** has kept the **United People’s Party Liberal (UPPL)** in suspense about its status in the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) ahead of the 2026 Assam Assembly elections.  **Raju Kumar Narzary**, UPPL general secretary, wrote to **Dilip Saikia**, State BJP president, seeking clarity on their alliance status. The BPF, a previous ally, is now being considered for a larger share of seats in the upcoming election.

recent_articles.title: BJP announces first list of candidates for 144 seats for Bengal Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) announced its first list of 144 candidates for the upcoming West Bengal Assembly election. The list includes prominent figures like **Suvendu Adhikari**, who will contest from two constituencies, and former state president **Dilip Ghosh**.  The party has nominated 41 sitting MLAs and three former legislators. The election will be held in two phases on April 23 and 29, with the results announced on May 4.

recent_articles.title: Peaceful coexistence, unity, harmony define India: Ramchander Rao at ‘Iftar’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
**N. Ramchander Rao**, **Telangana BJP president**, spoke at an Iftar hosted by the party's minority wing on Sunday, emphasizing the strength of India's diverse society. He stated that India's pluralistic ethos is unique in the world, with Christians, Sikhs, Muslims, Parsis and Hindus living together harmoniously.  **Rao** highlighted the importance of religious freedom and expressed his belief that people should be free to practice their faiths without interference. 

He emphasized that India's strength lies in its ability for people from all religions to live peacefully together, citing the Prime Minister's slogan "Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, Sabka Vishwas, Sabka Prayas" as a reflection of this spirit. **Rao** also stressed that despite differences in religion or region, they are all Indians first and foremost, united by a shared desire to move the nation forward together.  

Earlier in his speech, **Rao** welcomed former BRS leaders into the BJP, highlighting the party's commitment to fighting against "anti-people policies" of the Congress government in Telangana. He also criticized the proposed division of the GHMC as driven by political motives.

recent_articles.title: Odisha BJP shifts its MLAs to Paradip ahead of Rajya Sabha polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
## Odisha MLAs Head to Paradip for Rajya Sabha Vote

Ahead of the March 16th Rajya Sabha elections, all BJP MLAs in Odisha have been moved to the port town of Paradip. The move comes as a strategic decision by the party, which is confident of securing three out of four seats.  The MLAs will be staying at a luxury hotel owned by party leader Dilip Ray, who is an Independent candidate in the election. BJP leaders are preparing for the vote with training sessions and have expressed confidence in their candidates' chances. Meanwhile, BJD MLAs met with party president Naveen Patnaik on Saturday evening, while Congress MLA Dasarathi Gomango remains unreachable.  The outcome of the elections will be closely watched as the contest is expected to be between BJP candidate Dilip Ray and BJD-supported common candidate Dr Datteswar Hota for the fourth seat.

recent_articles.title: Fertilizer stocks for kharif: Centre struggles to avoid crisis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
## Fertilizer Shortage Looms as India Prepares for Kharif Season

A parliamentary committee has warned of potential fertilizer shortages ahead of the upcoming kharif season, citing geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions. The committee highlighted India's heavy reliance on imports for key fertilizers like urea, DAP, and potash, making it vulnerable to global market fluctuations and international conflicts.  While the government claims adequate stockpiles exist, the committee urges a proactive strategy to safeguard the country's fertilizer supply chain. This includes establishing a "Fertiliser Supply Security Fund" to address India's dependence on imports for critical inputs. The committee also pointed out that despite increased domestic production of some fertilizers, overall consumption remains high, leading to continued reliance on imports.
